Starting an 8h bounded sase-monitor wait that, the instant SSH succeeds, clones kit revision 16153bf56 + core pin 0504155 into a non-worktree scratch on Darwin, builds sase_core_rs from source in a throwaway uv venv, runs the kit test lane, rehearses backup/plan/run/verify/restore against copies of mac ~/.sase only, completes the deferred G3 probe, and rsyncs evidence to /home/bryan/cutover-backups/sase-x7-2-1-5-mac-leg/mac-evidence/. Will not substitute a Linux run. Will not touch mac's live editable install or run sase update.

ATTEMPT 1 FAILED (bead left open): mac became reachable 2026-09-06T04:10:15-04:00 after ~3.5h of the 8h wait (Kellys-MBP, Darwin 26.5/arm64, user bbugyi). Isolated rehearsal started; toolchain ok (cargo/rustc 1.95.0, uv 0.11.15, Python 3.12.5); iCloud check passed ($HOME/cutover-backups not iCloud-synced; 61Gi free). G3 was in progress (uv-tool sase 0.17.1 editable from ~/projects/github/sase-org/sase; no launchd sase/axe agents; cron is bob-only) and cut off at `du -sh ~/.sase`. SSH dropped 04:26:29-04:00 (rc=255, connection timed out); wrapper-STATUS=failed ssh_rc=255; STATUS.json still outcome=running. No clone, maturin build, pytest, or backup/purge/restore ran. Live ~/.sase and the live install were not mutated (G3 was read-only; copy/apply never started). Partial evidence snapshotted at /home/bryan/cutover-backups/sase-x7-2-1-5-mac-leg/mac-evidence-attempt1/. Starting attempt 2 with the same 8h wait, but the Darwin job is nohup+caffeinate -dim and Athena polls/rsyncs so a wifi blip does not kill it. Will not substitute a Linux run.
